_doc: Upstream projects whose protocol LectureFlow reimplemented without copying code (SPEC-v3 V14.6): their copyright and license notices are kept in THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md (section 9, texts in Appendix A). Each entry needs name, version, license (judged against the AGPL-3.0 table), copyright, source, what was used, the changes, and license_text: a copy of the upstream license file in packaging/licenses/texts/ with its sha256. When details names a file, that file must mention "<name> <version>" (keeps internal/colab/UPSTREAM.md and this table in step).

references.name: google-colab-cli
references.artifact: google_colab_cli-0.7.5-py3-none-any.whl (sha256 2b303ed21ebd6da829f80d506224a6cd4f0e62d506fb373166d06a0532e516a9), read 2026-10-24, not installed, not run
references.used: The protocol between the Colab CLI and the Colab service (ADC credentials and scopes, /tun/m assign / unassign / assignments / ccu-info, XSRF and proxy tokens, Jupyter Contents API and kernel execution on the runtime).
references.changes: Reimplemented in Go from the protocol; no upstream source was copied or translated line by line. Differences from upstream (queueing with back-off on 412, narrowed refresh scopes, token revocation, chunked uploads, own client agent string, no console/ssh) are listed in internal/colab/UPSTREAM.md.
references.license_text_source: google_colab_cli-0.7.5.dist-info/licenses/LICENSE in the wheel (the Apache-2.0 text; the copyright line is from the source file headers)

references.used: Only the Jupyter kernel channel protocol: kernel REST calls (start, list, shut down) and the WebSocket message framing of the kernel channels.
references.changes: Reimplemented in Go from the protocol; no upstream source was copied or translated line by line. The WebSocket client is LectureFlow's own minimal RFC 6455 implementation.
